root_cause: Three required main-release workflows use Playwright 1.55.0. Hosted Ubuntu 26.04-x64 runner rejects the Chromium installer with ERROR: Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64; CI retries do not change deterministic package/OS incompatibility. Provider Netlify production deployment can already be READY while DOM/browser proof fails.
prevention_rule: Production-release browser proof must use a pinned Playwright release that supports the runner OS; align all three workflow overrides with the shared installer and lock with a no-dependency regression. Never skip browser verification, bypass protected merges, simulate screenshots or mark provider-readback green when Chromium is unavailable.
